changes: Round 13: new damage build (the existing one is support) — style sources: tracklock pro Viscous last 30 days, an all-damage item set (no support items in any phase) (27 games: Mystic Burst 93%, HV 74%, Mystic Shot 67%, Express Shot 63%, Tankbuster 96%, Spirit Snatch 81%, Spirit Strike 70%, Warp Stone 48%, Extra Charge 41%, Mystic Expansion 74%, Superior Cooldown 74%, Greater Expansion 70%, Compress Cooldown 44%, Spirit Burn 37%, Boundless 26%), deadlocklabs.gg meta consensus 'MB build' (Mystic Burst, Spirit Strike, Mystic Expansion, Extra Spirit, Improved Spirit, Compress/Superior Cooldown, Greater Expansion, Spirit Resilience 7/8), lockbuilds 'Splatter Punch Viscous', 'Spirit Ballin 4.1' (12,401), 'Fistcous' (10,889). Splatter 55 + 0.7x, T1 +36, so Mystic Burst clears 80 from point 2. Puddle Punch has a charge (1, +1 at T1), so Extra Charge/Rapid Recharge work. Order: seemeta most popular (54.2%, 1,298 matches) 1123141322233444, Splatter maxed by point 7. Notes empty per UPDATE 3 except the Warp Stone play tip, counters, sells and slot locked.

Round 14: renamed (old name 33 chars and a copy of a lockbuilds title); Spirit Resilience out of core (its empty note showed the site default 'Haze, Viper...', and it's a counter) and into Counters; Melee Lifesteal -> Lifestrike in its place as the health spike (tracklock Viscous core has Melee Lifesteal; lockbuilds Splatter Punch and Fistcous run Lifestrike), health 4.8k still at 12k with 9 slots; Warp Stone moved to Late and Extra Charge bought right before Rapid Recharge so slot 10 isn't needed before ~25k; counters caption now 'after Lifestrike'; Mystic Reverb sells Rapid Recharge (Mystic Shot is the counters sell); Counterspell note fixed.
Round 15: Divine Barrier added to the rich box with 'If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.' (Dispel Magic is in Counters; Kieran's layout rule).

Round 19: made it the real public Splatter-punch style (Splatter Punch Viscous 691940, Fistcous 275231): added Melee Charge → Crushing Fists (both builds' punch core) and Extra Health → Fortitude (Splatter Punch greens); cut Mystic Shot (Viscous fires every 0.21s, so one bonus bullet every 8s adds little), Express Shot, High-Velocity Rounds and Warp Stone (not in the style's core). Mystic Reverb on Splatter moved from rich to core.
Round 20: late list Escalating Exposure, Witchmail, Refresher; core+late 72k.

Round 23: Puddle Punch damage is 20 + 0.6x light melee damage, and T3 makes it heavy melee (0.6x heavy + 40), so Melee Charge and Crushing Fists also raise the punch; Melee Charge says so. Dispel Magic out of Counters (The Cube T3 purges debuffs on yourself), so its Divine Barrier upgrade is out of the late list.
Round 25: ability order 1123141322233444 -> 1132343131442242 (worked out from the kit for this build's playstyle).
Cost pass: Improved Spirit moved to the start of Mid (was a late buy of a cheap upgrade).
